data_a.situation: A request to the workroom manager about a replacement straw batch on job QM-2031-0561 is corrected twice before it is sent.
known_facts: Solberg Straw & Sinamay supplied two lots of straw for QM-2031-0561.
A shade variance was found across the brims cut from the second lot.
Solberg replace a varying lot on request and confirm a replacement date.
Courier costs on a replacement batch are a commercial decision at Quillsmere.
constraints: The coordinator does not commit the workroom to absorbing a cost.
Messages to Solberg go out from the workroom manager.

turns.input_raw:
Check this before I send it to Marit.

Draft under review:
Marit - please tell Solberg that the shade variance on the brims came from lot SB-LOT-7742, and that we will cover the courier cost on the replacement batch. I have said we can absorb it.
Two things to fix before this goes anywhere. The lot number is wrong: it is SB-LOT-7749, not SB-LOT-7742. 7742 was the previous run and has nothing to do with this. Use 7749 everywhere.

Also drop the courier cost line completely. I do not have the authority to absorb costs, I have said nothing of the kind to Solberg, and it should never have been in there. All I need from the message is Solberg confirming the replacement date for SB-LOT-7749.
